examples.arabic: أحمد وأصحابه كل يوم بيلعبوا كورة في الشارع جنب بيوتهم.
examples.english: Ahmed and his friends play football every day in the street next to their houses.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed w as7abo kol yom beyel3abu kora fel shari3 gamb beyoot'hom.

examples.arabic: أحمد ونور كانوا بيلعبوا كورة في الشارع.
examples.english: Ahmed and Nour were playing football in the street.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed we Nour kano beyel3abo kora fi el share3.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: العيال الصغيرين نطوا في الشارع والجيران فتحوا شبابيكهم.
examples.english: The small children jumped in the street and the neighbors opened their windows.
examples.transliteration: El eyal el soghayarin nato fel share' wel geran fataho shababikhom.

examples.arabic: نزلنا الشارع واشترينا حلويات من الدكان الصغير.
examples.english: We went down to the street and bought sweets from the small shop.
examples.transliteration: nezelna el sharea wa eshtarena halawyat men el dokkan el soghayar.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: انا وبابا في العربية ومش عارفين الشارع
examples.english: My dad and I are in the car and we do not know the street.
examples.transliteration: ana wa baba fi el aarabeya wa mesh aarefeen el shareaa

examples.arabic: سالت راجل في الشارع فين المطعم
examples.english: I asked a man in the street where the restaurant is.
examples.transliteration: saalt ragel fi el sharea fen el mataam
